assumptions: A9 w := delta x when only x is given (harmonic share 0 by construction)
A10 v1 is graph-only (no 2-cells): no coexact part
A11 potential = minimum-norm solution of L0 x = d0^T w (orthogonal to H0); it is in node-stalk units, so with raw-unit stalks and scaling maps prefer nodes_by_incident_discord

h0.wording: certified residual: each eigenvalue lies within +-residual of a true eigenvalue (Weyl). The zero/nonzero labelling is a numerical policy (zero_rule), not a geometric kernel certificate; completeness of the Krylov search (no missed eigenvalue below the cut) is NOT certified; known-kernel dims are exact by construction.

h1.rule: rank-nullity on a graph: dim C1 - (dim C0 - h0); inherits the h0 cut

hodge.cochain: delta x (derived from node data; exact by construction, A9)

null_shuffled_values.note: degenerate = every shuffle gives the observed share (e.g. <2 edges per stalk-dim bucket, or a single cycle where shuffling preserves the loop sum): uninformative, not 'not significant'

L1_graph.nonzero_spectrum: equals L0 nonzero spectrum (d0^T d0 vs d0 d0^T)
